Priyom — quick answers and the POC mapping below. I’ve also attached a CSV export of the escalation roster we maintain.

Notification windows (summary):
- Detection -> internal confirmation (initial triage): target 2 hours for high-severity incidents; 8 hours for medium; 24 hours for low.
- Confirmation -> customer notification: target 72 hours for confirmed incidents involving customer PII or exfiltration of customer data. For availability/outage-only incidents we target next-business-day notification unless business-impacting SLA thresholds are met (then same-day).
- All timelines assume we have adequate signal for confirmation; if additional forensic work is required timelines may extend — we surface that to customers as an estimate.

POC matrix (phone/email):
- Detection/Alert: On-call SRE -> oncall@sre.redwood.ai, pager: +1-415-555-0101 (primary)
- Triage (0–24h): Incident Commander (Stephanie Nguyen) -> stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, mobile: +1-415-555-0123
- Investigation (24–72h): Lead Engineer (TBD) -> eng-oncall@redwood.ai; fallback: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
- External Disclosure/Communications: Head of Security (Rishi Malhotra) -> rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, +1-415-555-0145; Legal escalation: laura_bennett@redwood.ai (Legal Counsel)

Recommended handoff cadence: initial ticket + summary to customer-facing CS rep within 8 hours for high-severity; 24-hour status cadence until triage complete; executive notification only if material customer impact or regulatory trigger.

Attachment: Escalation_Roster.csv (roster stub)
